name: ModelPersistence
documentation:
Defines one durable representation of a {@link Model}.

A model may select both representations. When {@link #EVENT_SOURCED} is present, the event stream is authoritative; otherwise {@link #DOCUMENT} is authoritative. This set is independent from event publication and from internal documents used to compose model graphs.

enumConstants.name: DOCUMENT
enumConstants.documentation:
Persist an internal current-state source plus an independent public document projection.
 Document-only Model loads use the internal source, never an independently rewritten projection.
 Neither representation retains previous document versions.
 Include {@link #EVENT_SOURCED} when {@link Graph#previous()} or historical value comparison is required.

enumConstants.name: EVENT_SOURCED
enumConstants.documentation: Persist reconstructing events in the model event stream.
